caption.en: Figure 53.1 — Check four different conditions before execution.
caption.zh-hans: 图 53.1：执行前分别检查四种条件。

alt.en: Host-bound identity selects the north tenant; authorization limits own-order access; confinement limits process reach; a reviewed hash inventory detects changed dependencies. None implies the others.
alt.zh-hans: 宿主身份绑定 north 租户；授权限定本人订单；执行隔离约束进程访问范围；已审查的哈希清单检测依赖变化。四者不能相互替代。

credit.zh-hans: 原创教学图示 · CC BY-SA 4.0

text.zh-hans: 查询条件：租户 north 且所有者 mira

flow.en: The same ID in south belongs to leo and is shipped; an order ID alone is insufficient.
flow.zh-hans: south 中同名订单属于 leo，状态为已发货；只有订单 ID 不够。

text.zh-hans: 范围内的副作用＋审计回执

flow.en: An unchanged malicious package can pass a hash check. An isolated process can still misuse an authorized credential.
flow.zh-hans: 恶意包若未改动，也能通过哈希检查。隔离进程仍可能滥用已经拿到的凭据。
